title: Reading Drill — Measuring how books fade in windows — Building a comparison
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Measuring how books fade in windows — Building a comparison
passages.body:
**A** The bookseller had been asked to investigate display copies losing colour before they are sold in Foxhaven. Its first task was to decide which signs of improvement could be compared between sites. It settled on the change in cover colour, because the same measure could be applied in the original setting and at a second location.

**B** During a five-week comparison, the team used colour reference cards at both places. It recorded outcomes separately for each site. Because differing paper finishes might influence the figures, the team used a column in the record to show when that condition was present. The surveys included quiet periods as well as busy ones.

**C** The team then put forward swapped copies on display. Its report asked for another comparison after the change had been tried. This would distinguish a genuine effect from an improvement that could have occurred anyway. The report did not assume that the more successful site before the change would be the better site afterwards.
